title: Harry Reid's plan for a billion-dollar AAWSAP

tellings.quote: Harry Reid had an intention on turning into a turning it into an Manhattan project. uh he was intend this was like just to get it started and then the subsequent fiscal years that would follow. He was intending this to go like maybe a decade with worth a billion dollars maybe $2 billion worth of programmatics.

plain: A physicist named Eric Davis says that Harry Reid, a US senator, meant for AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial events that began in 2008, to be only a starting point. According to Davis, Reid wanted to grow it over about a decade into something like the Manhattan Project, the huge secret effort that built the atomic bomb, worth one or even two billion dollars. If true, it would mean a top senator once planned a major national push to study UFOs.
